HexKagune 1.3.11 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (protocol 59, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- NPCs now notice when you show what you are: your eyes (kakugan), your kagune, any kakuja (Rinkaku's, Ukaku's, the Owl, Graft's), and the worst (a final kakuja, the Dragon). They react when it goes up, within 16 blocks, if they can see you.
- Eto reacts by who you are to her: amused by a stranger's kagune, annoyed if it's out in her Library ("Not near my books."), interested in a kakuja; on her partner she's impressed (hearts), then worried as it gets worse ("Come back to me."), with a gesture to match. At most every 30 seconds per player (the worst forms always).
- Ghoul NPCs who don't know you are afraid of a kakuja and worse: they run (8 to 12 seconds), unless they're already at your throat; a kagune only makes them wary. Your own ghoul followers are impressed instead.
- Your children react too: a baby cries at a kakuja, a toddler hides ("Papa scary!"), a child is amazed, a teen pretends not to be.
- Built as one hook any NPC to come can listen to.
